visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Use a Stack Instead of Counters
visualizerParams.problemDescription: One counter per bracket type is used, which ignores nesting order. Rewrite it with a stack inside an is_balanced function. The output must stay the same for these inputs.

solution.explanation: Counters cannot tell that ([)] is wrong, because each type balances on its own. A stack remembers the order in which brackets were opened, so it is the correct tool, and a function makes it reusable.
